exampleEn: Sometimes you have to look the other way to keep the peace.
exampleKo: 때때로 평화를 유지하기 위해 눈을 감아야 할 때가 있다.
gameExamples: When faced with unethical behavior at work, many choose to look the other way.
It can be tempting to look the other way when a friend is making bad choices.
Some people prefer to look the other way rather than confront difficult truths.
